mapper.sql: v.doc_id AS document_id, v.id AS version_id, v.version_no, v.state_version, v.index_status, v.publication_policy, v.publication_evidence, r.id AS review_id, r.round_no, r.state AS review_state, r.submitted_at
mapper.select: SELECT , NULL::text AS title, (u.clearance_level >= d.security_level AND ) AS can_read FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id JOIN kb_space s ON s.id = d.space_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = #{actor} JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM kb_document_review WHERE version_id = v.id ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1) r ON TRUE WHERE u.enabled = TRUE AND dept.enabled = TRUE AND s.archived = FALSE AND d.status NOT IN ('deleted', 'archived') AND (v.uploader_user_id = #{actor} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_review own WHERE own.version_id = v.id AND own.submitted_by = #{actor})) AND v.id < #{beforeId} ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , d.title, TRUE AS can_read FROM kb_document_review r JOIN kb_document_version v ON v.id = r.version_id AND v.doc_id = r.doc_id JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id JOIN kb_space s ON s.id = d.space_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = #{actor} JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.id = u.dept_id WHERE AND (r.submitted_at, v.id) < (#{beforeTime}, #{beforeId}) ORDER BY r.submitted_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
